component.name: 白い熊 Svalboard
component.summary: Configure a Svalboard keyboard directly, without a browser

description.p: A native configurator for the Svalboard, for KDE Plasma on Wayland. It talks to the keyboard over hidraw, so no browser and no WebHID are involved.
It reads the board's own definition, so the layout it draws is whatever the firmware reports rather than an assumption, and keycodes can be searched across every category at once.
The first complete release: keymap, macros, tap dances, combos, key overrides, QMK settings, a key tester that reads the switch matrix, and backups in .kbi, .vil and QMK header form.
